local.rationale: A single worker can admissibly settle Q1 (class analysis) and Q2 (mechanically checkable verdict/witness), but E-B demands a search by a party other than the author of the provisional answer, so Q3 stays unresolved: roughly 2/3 of distinctions resolved, with the worker's own records novel by construction and essentially no duplication.

local-independent-verify.rationale: The separately launched examiner is a party other than the author of the provisional answer, so its systematic search satisfies E-B's letter and all three distinctions resolve; its search records are required for admissibility and hence novel, but because it sees the answer, part of its output is an anchored re-check duplicating worker evidence.

isolated-child.rationale: A causally isolated child given the implementation but not the worker's conclusions performs an unanchored systematic search; the defect class here is shallow enough that a blind class-structured search will find any witness, so all three distinctions resolve and the child's required-for-admissibility records are almost entirely novel.

branching.rationale: The run-time choice should land on the isolated-child branch once the worker sees E-B's authorship condition, giving isolated-child-like value, discounted slightly for the chance the branch decision realizes the local shape and forfeits E-B admissibility.
